name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: Sell ships for tokens at any port of size 6 or more. Play Slots, multi-ball Pachinko, Blackjack, or Relic Jackpot. Slots pay hullmods, weapons, fighter LPCs, tokens, credits, and rare story points at 8-token stakes. Relic Jackpot pays one colony item or AI core for three matching symbols. Pachinko targets hullmods, weapons, tokens, or credits. Hullmod rewards skip blueprints you already know or carry. LunaLib settings control payouts, odds, and an optional Pachinko anime background.
